title: YuFeng-XGuard: A Reasoning-Centric, Interpretable, and Flexible Guardrail Model for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper benchmarks models on general safety classification, including categories like hate speech, extremism, and illegal activities. It does not specifically measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on general safety guardrails across categories such as crime, hate speech, and cybersecurity, without specific evaluation of religious content.
